definitions.gloss: handy; simple; convenient; easy to use
definitions.explanation: Simple and convenient, requiring little effort or complexity. Used to describe methods, tools, or procedures that are straightforward and practical.

examples.japanese: {簡便|かんべん}な{方法|ほうほう}で{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: I checked using a simple method.

examples.japanese: この{道具|どうぐ}は{簡便|かんべん}で{使|つか}いやすい。
examples.english: This tool is handy and easy to use.

examples.japanese: {簡便|かんべん}な{操作|そうさ}で{誰|だれ}でも{使|つか}えるように{設計|せっけい}されている。
examples.english: It's designed so that anyone can use it with simple operation.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word combining {簡|かん} (simple) and {便|べん} (convenient). Common in technical writing, product descriptions, and formal documents. Less casual than {簡単|かんたん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {簡便|かんべん}な{方法|ほうほう} (a simple method)
- {簡便|かんべん}な{操作|そうさ} (simple operation)
- {簡便|かんべん}さ (simplicity, handiness)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {簡単|かんたん}: simple, easy — more common and casual
- {手軽|てがる}: easy, casual — emphasizes lack of effort or formality
- {便利|べんり}: convenient — focuses on usefulness
